about: Penn State's strategic plan and the College of Arts and Architecture's Strategic Plan 2030, limited to the objectives HAX meets (confirmed by the platform owner, 2026-11-11). Plan structure and wording are a snapshot read from the plan pages on the date given; objective text is paraphrased (see the plan for the exact words). A&A's goal-to-priority alignment is A&A's own. pillars and nodes are ids in hax-ecosystem.mmd, sdgs are goal numbers in sdg-links.json, wins are headings in praw WINS.md. build_plans.py reads this file. Refresh by hand when a plan changes.

priorities.name: Enhancing Student Success
priorities.desc: Prepare students to be engaged citizens, employable, further educated, and able to drive positive change.

objectives.text: Advising, research advising, mentoring and class experiences that prepare students for their academic and professional futures.
Co-curricular experiences that align students' passions, aptitudes and ambitions and lead them to success in school and work.
wins: Site Dashboard, three generations of students (2022–2026)

objectives.text: Student, faculty and staff health and wellness, cultivated in a caring community focused on flourishing.
objectives.how: HAX is the platform behind the Learn to Flourish Hub's public site.

priorities.name: Growing (Inter)disciplinary Research Excellence
priorities.desc: Use the University's scholarship to address major challenges facing the Commonwealth, the nation and the world.
priorities.how: HAX meets this through A&A Goal 4: arts and design as research and practice.

priorities.name: Increasing Land-Grant Impact
priorities.desc: Contribute to the Commonwealth's economic development, workforce growth and overall vitality.

objectives.text: Use the University's assets and strategic partnerships to build resilient, sustainable communities for Pennsylvania.
objectives.how: hax.psu.edu is a shared asset: the Innovation Hub's site and the LaunchBox small-business training site started there.

objectives.text: Extend the academic enterprise through partnerships with business and industry, non-profits, communities and residents.
Galvanize an engaged and effective network of advocates and investors in Penn State.

priorities.name: Fostering Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging
priorities.desc: An inclusive environment where all students, faculty and staff can flourish.

objectives.text: Address institutional barriers to close student outcome gaps.

priorities.name: Transform Internal Operations
priorities.desc: The supporting element: initiatives that provide the infrastructure and support to carry out the plan's goals.
priorities.how: The plan lists no objectives for it; HAX does more with less, and A&A Goal 1 aligns to it.

goals.name: Build a culture of collaboration
goals.desc: Strengthen trust, connection and belonging across people, partnerships and programs.

subs.text: Reimagine shared physical spaces and systems to encourage collaboration.
subs.how: HAX Lab is a physical space for cross-discipline work like the Flourish Hub, student internships and collaborations.

subs.text: Build cross-disciplinary collaboration into curricula, research and creative practice.
Use collaboration to reduce administrative burden rather than add to workloads.

goals.name: Amplify our responsibility as a cultural bridge
goals.desc: Enrich campus, community and civic life across Pennsylvania and beyond.

subs.text: Expand artist residencies and student experiential opportunities.
wins: Site Dashboard, three generations of students (2022–2026)

subs.text: Embed human-centered design principles in courses, performances and creative practice.
wins: Site Dashboard, three generations of students (2022–2026)

subs.text: Strengthen A&A's visibility and partnerships at state, national and global levels.

goals.name: Empower learners to build the future

subs.text: Expose students to diverse career pathways through arts- and design-integrated experiential learning.
Build ethical AI literacy and future-ready skills into curricular and co-curricular experiences.
Expand A&A's role in General Education so all students can explore creativity and emerging technologies.
Develop new degrees, minors, certificates and hybrid learning models that match demand and workforce needs.

goals.name: Champion the arts and design as transformative forms of research and practice
goals.desc: Advance discovery, insight, influence and impact.

subs.text: Build cross-campus partnerships that raise the visibility and impact of arts and design.
wins: 640+ open HTML tags, used across Penn State

subs.text: Elevate recognition of A&A's creative activity, research and scholarship.
Lead University-wide human-centered use of AI in creative practice and research.

goals.name: Cultivate an equitable community for all
goals.desc: Every student, faculty member and staff member has the support, access and opportunities to thrive.

subs.text: Reduce or remove affordability and access barriers to participation.
